text: @wisexin/dsh-antigravity 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的模型提供方插件：它将 Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist 模型接入 DSH 的语言模型适配器，并提供设置面板与本地状态接口。用户可通过 Google OAuth 登录、查看账号配额、切换账号、管理启用模型，并在模型池限额时使用账号故障转移。适合希望在 DSH 对话中使用 Google Antigravity 编码模型并管理授权账号的用户。使用前需要 Google 账号；无需单独配置 API key。

@wisexin/dsh-antigravity brings Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist models to DSH Web through its LLM adapter. Google OAuth enables model use; the settings panel shows quotas, manages models and accounts, and supports account failover. Requires a Google account; no API key is needed.

@wisexin/dsh-antigravity 的功能「Antigravity 模型接入」：将模型适配器注册到 DSH 的 LLM 服务，使对话可选择 Antigravity 模型并发起模型请求。
@wisexin/dsh-antigravity 的功能「Google OAuth 登录」：在设置界面启动 Google 授权并保存账号凭据，也可通过命令行登录助手完成授权。
@wisexin/dsh-antigravity 的功能「配额与模型管理」：设置页可同步账号配额，并勾选启用模型；选择会保存并影响 DSH 聊天模型选择器。
@wisexin/dsh-antigravity 的功能「账号管理与故障转移」：用户可添加、切换或移除授权账号，并配置在配额耗尽时自动转到账号池中的下一个账号。
@wisexin/dsh-antigravity 使用前须知：插件依赖 Google OAuth 授权，模型请求、账号信息和配额查询会调用 Google API；需先在插件设置页完成登录。

@wisexin/dsh-antigravity README · dsh-antigravity：

English | [简体中文](./README.zh.md) Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist model provider plugin crafted for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). Access Google Cloud Code Assist's robust suite of coding models directly through Google OAuth with no API key required, featuring large context windows and advanced reasoning. ---

@wisexin/dsh-antigravity README · ✨ Features：- **Day-One Gemini 3.8 Flash Support**: Full native support for Google's latest `gemini-3.8-flash-tiered` with 1M context window, direct model targeting, and configurable thinking levels (Low / Medium / High), defaulting to helpful low-level reasoning.
- **Intelligent Endpoint Auto-Failover & 429 Resilience**:
  - **Three-Tier Endpoint Chain (Daily → Sandbox → PROD)**: `daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com` (the official IDE native primary endpoint) is now the default first choice with zero extra round-trip latency, followed by the `daily-cloudcode-pa.sandbox.googleapis.com` sandbox, and the legacy `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com` as last-resort fallback. Pin a single endpoint with `ANTIGRAVITY_BASE_URL`.
  - **Accurate 429 Classification**: Only responses that genuinely indicate exhausted account quota (`RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` quota wording) surface a live reset countdown. Endpoint-level rate limiting is handled by backoff and endpoint progression instead of being misreported as "quota exhausted".

@wisexin/dsh-antigravity README · Option 3: From Local Tarball：```sh
npm run pack:dist
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dist/wisexin-dsh-antigravity-0.1.12.tgz
```

Restart DSH:
```sh
dsh web
```

@wisexin/dsh-antigravity README · 🔐 Authentication：> On headless servers where the browser cannot be launched automatically, run the CLI login helper on the same machine:
> ```sh
> node "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-antigravity/bin/antigravity-login.mjs"
> ```

@wisexin/dsh-antigravity README · 📋 Model Catalog：> Note: Google's model supply changes over time. Retired models are hidden from the catalog automatically, and requests targeting them fall back to a verified model in the same family — no manual switching required.
